description: Creates a shape with the parameters specified.

params.description: The shape type which specifies the preset shape geometry.
params.name: shapeType

params.description: The shape width in English measure units.
params.name: width

params.description: The shape height in English measure units.
params.name: height

params.description: The color or pattern used to fill the shape. If not specified, the default shape style fill (theme accent) is used.
params.name: fill

params.description: The stroke used to draw the shape outline. If not specified, the default shape style outline (theme accent) is used.
params.name: stroke

signature: CreateShape(shapeType?: ShapeType, width?: EMU, height?: EMU, fill?: ApiFill, stroke?: ApiStroke): ApiShape
